topic: Someone discovers their partner has been writing a novel about them
text:
You ever notice how folks see everything in shadows and light, till one day, they're the ones casting the shadows? Found out my partner's been scribing a novel, me as the lead. Says it's just a story, a loose sketch of our nights, our days. But there's a gleam in their eye when they talk about how it all plays out. The city's a character too, the rain's a lot like a chorus, always there, setting the scene.

I don't ask many questions, but the way they talk, like they're telling a tale to themselves, makes me wonder. Maybe I'm just a character in a story they're trying to write themselves into. But that's the thing with stories, they always have more than one ending. We'll see how this chapter plays out.
